podcast.body: The release of this album was significantly delayed for months due to major censorship problems related to its controversial cover art. The band refused to change the cover, eventually resorting to releasing the album inside a black plastic sleeve that concealed the interior. Despite the issues, the album received critical acclaim upon its release and later became an underground icon. "el lanzamiento de No Love de Web quedaría redrasado durante meses por enormes problemas censurados con su portada."

This album marked the beginning of a later stage in Dead Grips' career, which has garnered a strong following among other segments of their fanbase. "hay gente que le encanta la última etapa después del No Love de Huevina delante"
